results.title: Many states deciding control of the Senate are seeing a big boost in early voting, AP analysis shows
results.description: WASHINGTON — Voter turnout is soaring compared with the last midterm election in many of the states that are expected to decide control of the U.S. Senate, according to an Associated Press analysis of early voting two weeks before Election…

results.title: No repatriation if returnees face persecution in Myanmar
results.description: KUALA LUMPUR: No individual will be repatriated if there is clear evidence or risk that they would face persecution, torture or threats to their life in Myanmar, says Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution Ismail.

results.title: Thai army on October 22 accuses Cambodia of using Preah Vihear as a military base
results.description: Thailand’s army cites self-defence and alleges Cambodia deployed weapons at Preah Vihear, rejecting claims of unlawful attacks.
